rationale: The plan specifies DESeq2 Wald on ~condition for an unpaired, single-batch 6v6 design with an edgeR QL cross-check, which fits the stated data state and replicate structure, and it correctly omits batch or pairing terms that do not exist. QC precedes testing with blind VST PCA, Euclidean sample-distance heatmap, and library-size/detected-gene plots, with an explicit keep-or-remove policy for sample_01 that requires a stated defect rather than depth alone. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, justified as the smaller group size) is minimal and reasonable though slightly more mechanical than filterByExpr; normalization is explicitly kept inside the models (median-of-ratios / TMM) with no pre-scaling. Contrast, reference level, apeglm shrinkage, BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, p-value histogram, and Cook's-distance NA accounting are all stated; enrichment uses the full ranked list by Wald statistic against Hallmark 2026.1 with a 15-500 size window, seed, and stated universe. The report step names versions, design, thresholds, tested and significant gene counts, sample_01 propagation, and design caveats, meeting the reference on every point.
